summary: The note is a brief biographical entry on Tim Sherrill, born September 10, 1965. It describes him as a former Major League Baseball left-handed relief pitcher. He appeared in 18 games for the St. Louis Cardinals between 1990 and 1991.
one_line: Tim Sherrill is a former MLB left-handed relief pitcher who played 18 games for the St. Louis Cardinals from 1990 to 1991.
key_facts: Tim Sherrill was born on September 10, 1965.
Tim Sherrill is a former Major League Baseball (MLB) left-handed relief pitcher.
Tim Sherrill played in 18 games for the St. Louis Cardinals.
Tim Sherrill's time with the St. Louis Cardinals spanned 1990–1991.
